title: Explicit vs Implicit Representations: A Systematic Comparison of GA-Planes, K-Planes, and NeRF for 2D Matrix Reconstruction

contributions.purpose: 首次系统对比 INR 架构在 2D 矩阵重建上的表现
contributions.mechanism: 参数匹配下对比 K-Planes/GA-Planes/NeRF 十种配置,PSNR 评估
contributions.evaluation: 360 次实验(仅单张 512×512 astronaut 图),最优 GA-Planes 27.67±2.61 dB
contributions.domain: 隐式神经表示 / 矩阵重建
contributions.source_quote: We present the first systematic comparison of INR architectures—GA-Planes, K-Planes (a subset of GA-Planes), and NeRF variants—adapted for 2D matrix reconstruction tasks.

contributions.purpose: 验证显式因子分解优于坐标编码
contributions.mechanism: K-Planes(multiply,nonconvex) 对比 NeRF 最优
contributions.source_quote: K-Planes (multiply, nonconvex) achieves 27.43±2.42 dB compared to NeRF's best of 12.41±0.41 dB, representing a 15.02 dB improvement

contributions.purpose: 提出设计原则(特征组合与解码器)
contributions.mechanism: 乘性 vs 加性、非凸 vs 线性解码器分组对比
contributions.source_quote: Multiplicative feature combination surpasses additive by 7.5 dB, and nonconvex decoders exceed linear by 6.9 dB

contributions.mechanism: 对比 K-Planes 与 NeRF 参数量
contributions.source_quote: K-Planes achieves superior performance with 40% fewer parameters than NeRF.

self_declared_provenance.quote: a systematic comparison of INR architectures—GA-Planes, K-Planes (a subset of GA-Planes), and NeRF variants—adapted for 2D matrix reconstruction tasks

notes: 数据红旗:自称 comprehensive evaluation across 360 experiments,但训练/评估只在单张 512×512 astronaut 图上(single image, single dataset),checklist 自认 single dataset validation limitation,泛化性存疑;多处幻影引用未解析 [?](Kim & Fridovich-Keil [?]、BSD100 [?]、multi-scale [?]、few-shot [?]、neural compression [? ?])——破损/占位文献引用红旗。over-claim:'strongest empirical evidence in INR literature'、'paradigm shift' 建立在单图之上。trade-off:非凸解码器 +6.88 dB 但参数翻倍。无明确 provenance 声称 replace,仅 adapt 3D 方法到 2D。
